main_text.head: Cæteri reges Atheniensium.
main_text.p: acc.Successère ei reges alienigenæ: quod hoc modo accidit. page.notes: Left margin: edge damage and marginal marks are partly unreadable; "acc." and the note beside "Hunc" are reproduced as far as they are visible. The Greek words at the start of the first paragraph are uncertain and marked [?]. "Athenienses & Bœotos" is the line where a fragment "Inos" appears at the start of the next line, which may be the end of a word hidden by the scan edge; it is not transcribed. The line "Melanthus Andropompi" is partly hidden at the line start and is uncertain. "Pe-" and "moni" are a split word, probably Periclymeni, but the middle part is not legible. "abepos" is uncertain, probably "ab Pelope", and is not reconstructed. The word "civi-" ends the page with a hyphen, and no catchword is visible.
